summary: fractal-web exposes optimistic winning-Sidebar arrangement edits with typed refusals and explicit stale-fence retry

replay.detail: Client-only change; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing arrangement.edit operations and control.arrangements grants. New Sidebars use the reserved subject arrangement/<owner>/00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001, shared by concurrent clients and adopted by identity even after rename. Otherwise the lowest UUIDv7 exact-name live person-owned legacy Sidebar wins, with a non-blocking duplicate note and no automatic consolidation. Retired reserved subjects cannot be restored; terminal refusal is remembered for the session, while an explicit retry of a definitively refused create can adopt a later-visible live legacy Sidebar. Uncertain delivery retries retain their original target. Read-only pairings remain read-only.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the app is not deployed by this change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change. Optimistic edit and retry state remains in memory only.
